INSERT INTO sanad_offices (
  officeName, officeNameAr, slug, commercialRegistration, email, phone,
  governorate, wilayat, addressLine1, description, descriptionAr,
  ownerId, status, verificationStatus, createdAt
) VALUES
('Muscat Business Services Center', 'مركز خدمات الأعمال مسقط', 'muscat-business-center', 'CR-2024-001', 
 'info@muscatbusiness.om', '+968 24 123456', 'Muscat', 'Al Khuwair', 
 'Building 123, Al Khuwair Street', 
 'Full-service business center offering company registration and legal documentation',
 'مركز خدمات أعمال متكامل يقدم تسجيل الشركات والوثائق القانونية',
 (SELECT id FROM users WHERE openId = 'owner_001' LIMIT 1), 'active', 'verified', NOW()),
 
('Salalah Legal Documentation Office', 'مكتب صلالة للوثائق القانونية', 'salalah-legal-docs', 'CR-2024-002',
 'contact@salalah-legal.om', '+968 23 987654', 'Dhofar', 'Salalah',
 'Al Hafah District, Building 45',
 'Specialized in legal documentation and notarization services',
 'متخصص في الوثائق القانونية وخدمات التوثيق',
 (SELECT id FROM users WHERE openId = 'owner_002' LIMIT 1), 'active', 'verified', NOW()),
 
('Sohar Business Hub', 'مركز صحار للأعمال', 'sohar-business-hub', 'CR-2024-003',
 'info@soharhub.om', '+968 26 555123', 'Al Batinah North', 'Sohar',
 'Sohar Industrial Area, Zone 3',
 'One-stop shop for business registration and licensing',
 'محطة واحدة لتسجيل الأعمال والترخيص',
 (SELECT id FROM users WHERE openId = 'owner_001' LIMIT 1), 'active', 'pending_verification', NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE officeName=VALUES(officeName);
